; ----------------------------------------
; Shared memory arrays
; Memory loads are modeled as array selects by bit width
; ----------------------------------------
(declare-const mem32 (Array (_ BitVec 64) (_ BitVec 32)))
; ----------------------------------------
; Parameters for mem_pointer_store_then_read
; (Bit widths from Ghidra analysis)
; ----------------------------------------
(declare-const param_1_1 (_ BitVec 64))  ; unsigned
(declare-const param_2_1 (_ BitVec 32))  ; signed
; ----------------------------------------
; Parameters for mem_pointer_store_then_read
; (Bit widths from Ghidra analysis)
; ----------------------------------------
(declare-const param_1_2 (_ BitVec 64))  ; unsigned
(declare-const param_2_2 (_ BitVec 32))  ; signed
; ----------------------------------------
; Parameter equality constraints
; For matching bit widths: direct equality unless semantic narrowing is inferred
; For different bit widths: overlapping bits equal, upper bits free
; ----------------------------------------
; param_1_1 and param_1_2: same width (64bit)
(assert (= param_1_1 param_1_2))
; param_2_1 and param_2_2: same width (32bit)
(assert (= param_2_1 param_2_2))
(assert (not (or (not (distinct param_1_2 (_ bv0 64))) (distinct param_1_2 (_ bv0 64)))))
(check-sat)
(get-model)
